<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SeparatorProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/separator'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { Separator } from '@/styles/vase-lyra/ui/separator'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ SeparatorProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  orientation: 'vertical',
})
</script>

<template>
  <Separator
    data-slot="button-group-separator"
    :orientation="orientation"
    :class="cn(
      'bg-input relative self-stretch data-horizontal:mx-px data-horizontal:w-auto data-vertical:my-px data-vertical:h-auto',
      props.class,
    )"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import type { ButtonGroupVariants } from '.'
import { cn } from 'cn'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap | Component
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  orientation?: ButtonGroupVariants['orientation']
}>(), {
  as: 'div',
})
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    role="group"
    :data-orientation="props.orientation"
    :class="cn('bg-muted gap-2 rounded-none border px-2.5 text-xs font-medium [&_svg:not([class*=size-])]:size-4 flex items-center [&_svg]:pointer-events-none', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>
